# meshmsg v0.1.24

This release adds line-oriented streaming sends and an installable agent skill for using meshmsg from coding agents.

## Streaming sends

- Adds `send-stream [--to <recipient>]` to send each nonempty stdin line immediately as a separate broadcast or private message, including input from `tail -f`.
- Preserves `send --message-stdin` as a one-shot input source that waits for EOF.
- Supports LF/CRLF framing and a final unterminated record at EOF, with bounded buffering and the existing UTF-8 message-size limits.
- Generates a separate operation ID for every message and emits per-message NDJSON results with `--json`.
- Stops on the first error without automatic retries or private-to-broadcast fallback. Interrupting an outstanding send reports its operation ID and an unknown outcome.
- Adds unit, fake-IPC, and real-peer coverage for framing, limits, privacy, errors, and cancellation.

Example private log stream (use the recipient's full public key):

```sh
tail -n 0 -f app.log | meshmsg --json send-stream --to '<full-peer-key>'
```

Streaming sends remain independent messages, not a durable byte stream. Existing rate and replay limits apply. Acceptance does not imply durable delivery or reading.

## Agent skill and documentation

- Adds `meshmsg skill install` to install the bundled skill into the shared agent skills directory, with explicit Claude, Codex, and Pi targets available through `--agent`.
- Keeps installation idempotent and requires `--force` before replacing a different existing skill file.
- Documents streaming sends, safe retry handling, private messaging, and attachment workflows in the bundled skill and usage reference.

## Compatibility

This is a CLI-only addition. Local IPC remains protocol v4 and broadcast envelopes remain version 3; no daemon protocol migration is introduced.

Install this exact source release after the tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.24 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.23...v0.1.24
